notes: The opening identifies the script-X object with an amalgamated sum of barred W and the coproduct of barred U_i over the coproduct of B_i, and the following display identifies it with a coproduct of X_i. The parenthesized index letter remains w/W.

The adjacent drawing has three rounded regions, an inner thickened Y, labels B_1/B_2/B_3 and C_1/C_2/C_3, and K beneath. The right display compares X with a doubtful w/i suffix to script X_i and to Im X_i, glossed “ouvert de” script X.
The live map to X is described as étale at points outside the coproduct of C_i and as an “imm fermée” at points of that coproduct.

Item 6 asks for an “Énoncé d’invariance” under replacing K by K-star contained in K and restricting the U_i and primed U_i. It gives an inserted boundary/union condition, a closure-intersection condition for every i, and a parenthetical sufficient condition using int K-prime. The tiny raised marks of the inserted primed-U equation remain wedge/star.

The slanted note reads “vérifier l’énoncé précis…”. The final paragraph asks whether the earlier “div. hypothèses” should have required union C_i to lie in int K, followed by the written equivalent condition C_i intersect dotted K empty for every i in I.
The manuscript page number is 5. No date or independent title is written on this page; the numbered item begins with “6) Énoncé”.
